title: Foreign Affairs Analyst: Vietnam Trade Deal Signals Major Realignment Away From China
text:
President Donald Trump announced a new trade deal with Vietnam just days before his tariff deadline. Foreign affairs analyst Gerard Filitti joined NTD’s Tiffany Meier to discuss how the deal fits into Trump’s broader economic strategy, what it means for reshoring and U.S.–China competition, and what could come next with India and Japan.
